topIssues.title: Update superchain explainer
topIssues.author: bradleycamacho
topIssues.body:
## Description

https://docs.optimism.io/get-started/superchain

Shorten signifantly and ensure we are positioning Superchain values and intent very clearly. Ping @bradleycamacho as needed for this issue as it might be a large lift

## Action items

1. Do research on topic and raise any questions with the docs team
2. Write a first draft. It doesn't have to be worded perfectly as the docs team will review
3. Ping @bradleycamacho on discord and request review
4. Implement feedback from @bradleycamacho 
5. Publish

topPRs.title: chore: update OP Stack terminology across documentation
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Updates navigation structure in `docs.json`: removes the `superchain/` section, moves content to `op-stack/` and consolidates pages
- Removes or merges pages that were specific to the Superchain umbrella concept (superchain-explainer, revenue explainer, registry page)
- Adds `op-stack/ecosystem/` section with the superchain-registry page and `op-stack/protocol/blockspace-charter.mdx`
- Updates terminology across ~100 documentation files to use consistent OP Stack framing
- Fixes broken internal links resulting from moved/removed pages
- Adds redirects in `docs.json` for all removed and moved pages

## Test plan

- [x] `mint broken-links` passes (one pre-existing broken link in `chain-operators/guides/features/blobs.mdx` unrelated to this change)
- [x] All renamed/moved pages have redirects in `docs.json`
- [x] Navigation structure in `docs.json` validated
- [x] Product names preserved: Superchain Faucet, Superchain paymaster, Superchain Token List, Superchain Bridges UI, Superscan, Superchain Dev Console
- [x] Technical identifiers preserved: SuperchainERC20, SuperchainTokenBridge, SuperchainETHBridge, SuperchainConfig, superchain-registry (repo), superchain-ops (repo), superchain_level, superchain_time
